features.name: LCA Math Engine (6 Models)
features.plain_english: Six ISO-grade algorithms: Matrix LCA (Heijings & Suh: h = Q·B·A⁻¹·f), Leontief EEIO (Nobel 1973: x = (I−A)⁻¹·y), TOPSIS MCDA (C = d⁻/(d⁺+d⁻)), Monte Carlo (50k runs, μₕ ± 1.96σₕ), Sensitivity (∂h/∂Aᵢⱼ), Non-Linear Dynamic LCA.

features.name: AI Document Extraction
features.plain_english: Uses Owl-Alpha LLM (via OpenRouter) to extract structured carbon data from unstructured PDF/Excel/CSV procurement documents. Outputs JSON with materials, energy, transport, and recommendations.

features.name: Graph RAG Chat System
features.plain_english: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Neo4j: converts supply chain graph into LLM context, sends to OpenRouter/Owl-Alpha, streams answers. Supports bilingual Thai/English with zero hallucination.

features.name: Emission Factor Search
features.plain_english: Real-time Google Search via Serper.dev for emission factors. Multi-query strategy per category (materials, transport, energy). Trusted URL allowlist (25+ domains: IPCC, EPA, TGO) + fallback DB (50+ materials) + in-memory cache.

features.name: App Shell & Sidebar
features.plain_english: Root layout with a fixed sidebar routing between Dashboard, Audit, Graph, Strategies, Reports, and Live Demo views. Owns global state (active analysis, audit history).

features.name: API Client (api.ts)
features.plain_english: Centralized Axios HTTP client wrapping all 19 FastAPI endpoints with typed request/response helpers.

features.name: Dashboard Page
features.plain_english: KPI cards (Supplier, Items, Carbon, Score), Plotly charts (hotspot bar, pie, Sankey flow), latest audit summary, top 3 recommendations.

features.name: Audit Page
features.plain_english: Upload PDF/Excel/CSV for AI analysis. Live ReactFlow supply chain graph on right. Full material/energy/transport data tables.

features.name: Graph Page (Neo4j)
features.plain_english: Full-screen ReactFlow supply chain graph: 5 node types (Project, Material, Energy, Transport, CarbonImpact), 4 relationships. Interactive: pan/zoom/click for details.

features.name: Strategies & AI Chat
features.plain_english: AI Strategy Consultant chat on left; Scope 1/2/3 recommendation cards on right. Users ask about hotspots, reduction strategies, material swaps in Thai/English.

features.name: Reports & History
features.plain_english: Selectable past-audit list with emissions breakdown, key metrics, AI summary, recommendations. Export: PDF (ISO 14067) and CSV. Similar Past Audits with match scores.

features.name: Live Demo View
features.plain_english: Competition demo walkthrough: speed comparison (21 days → 15s), real-time KPI cards, 4 tabbed analysis panels (Matrix LCA, Monte Carlo, Sensitivity, Non-Linear), matrix display (s, g, h vectors).

features.name: FastAPI Server
features.plain_english: 19-endpoint REST API: /analyze (upload), /graph (CRUD), /charts/* (6 types: hotspot, pie, sankey, tornado, monte-carlo, waterfall), /math/* (6 algorithms), /reports/pdf, /chat, /audits/similar.

features.name: PDF & Excel Analyzer
features.plain_english: Extracts text via PyMuPDF/Pandas, auto-detects headers, then calls Owl-Alpha LLM to identify materials, energy, transport with CO2e values, source URLs, and recommendations.

features.name: Analytics & Charts Engine
features.plain_english: 11 Plotly chart types: hotspot bar, emission pie, Sankey flow, Monte Carlo histogram, tornado sensitivity, TOPSIS radar, convergence plot, waterfall, non-linear comparison, treemap, and bar charts.

features.name: PDF Report Generator
features.plain_english: Creates professional ISO 14067 carbon footprint PDFs via ReportLab with embedded Plotly charts, data tables, and AI-generated recommendations.

features.name: Neo4j Database Layer
features.plain_english: Abstracts all Cypher queries. Writes supply chain graph: 5 node types (Project, Material, Energy, Transport, CarbonImpact), 4 relationships. Reads for ReactFlow and Graph RAG.

features.name: Audit Vector Memory
features.plain_english: In-memory + Pinecone vector store. Matches new audits to similar historical ones by material overlap using Sentence-BERT 384-dim embeddings and cosine similarity.

features.name: Configuration (.env)
features.plain_english: Loads OPENROUTER_API_KEY, NEO4J_URI, SERPER_API_KEY, PINECONE_API_KEY from .env via python-dotenv.

features.name: 6 Mathematical Models
features.plain_english: Six models: (1) Matrix LCA: h = Q·B·A⁻¹·f, (2) Leontief: x = (I−A)⁻¹·y with power series, (3) TOPSIS: 7-step MCDA ranking, (4) Monte Carlo: 50k-run uncertainty with 95% CI, (5) Sensitivity: ∂/∂Aᵢⱼ with SR ratios + tornado, (6) Non-Linear: A(s)·s = f with scale-dependent coefficients.

external_services.name: OpenRouter AI
external_services.purpose: LLM API gateway serving Owl-Alpha model for document extraction and Graph RAG chat. Temperature 0.1, top_p 0.9, frequency_penalty 0.3.

external_services.name: Serper.dev
external_services.purpose: Google Search API for real-time emission factor lookups. Multi-query per category, 25+ trusted domains, in-memory caching.

external_services.name: Neo4j AuraDB
external_services.purpose: Managed graph DB storing full supply chain as 5 node types + 4 relationships. Queried via Bolt protocol.

external_services.name: Pinecone Vector DB
external_services.purpose: Vector database for semantic audit search. 384-dim embeddings from Sentence-BERT, cosine similarity matching.
